XenotypeDef.label: devil bug
XenotypeDef.description: An insect momo of swarms and dark, damp places. Her feelers quiver at the scent of a man from rooms away, and once she has the smell of him she never tires and never stops — hunger and lust are the only thoughts she has room for.
XenotypeDef.descriptionShort: A simple, tireless insect momo who hunts men by scent.

XenotypeDef.label: giant ant
XenotypeDef.description: A worker caste momo of the deep nests. Honest and diligent, she digs through solid rock and carries loads larger than herself without complaint — though the pheromones in her sweat grow heavier the harder she works.
XenotypeDef.descriptionShort: A diligent, strong insect momo born to dig and haul.

XenotypeDef.label: soldier beetle
XenotypeDef.description: Heavy cavalry from birth. Her exoskeleton turns aside swords and arrows, her claws are ripper-blades, and hidden beneath the carapace on her back are wings for short bursts of flight. Calm, obedient and nearly expressionless — until she chooses a man to escort.
XenotypeDef.descriptionShort: An armoured, obedient insect momo with ripper claws and hidden wings.

XenotypeDef.label: greenworm
XenotypeDef.description: A soft-bodied, gentle momo who loves nothing more than eating. Her antennae secrete a strange-smelling substance that saps the strength of anything that threatens her — and she spits the same sludge in fright.
XenotypeDef.descriptionShort: A soft, gentle insect momo who spits acidic sludge.

XenotypeDef.label: vamp mosquito
XenotypeDef.description: The vampire of the insect world. Cunning and mean, she stalks her prey on buzzing wings and strikes when their guard drops. Her bite carries a venom that makes the wound hot and throbbing — and only her touch soothes it. She drinks blood most greedily in her lover's arms.
XenotypeDef.descriptionShort: A winged, blood-drinking insect momo with a venomous bite.

XenotypeDef.label: abaddon
XenotypeDef.description: Daughter of the bug mamono lord who nearly devoured the world in antiquity. Quiet and spacey rather than ferocious, but her appetite — and her fertility — are without limit. Her pheromones command the swarm, her wingbeats shake the heavens, and once she devotes herself to a man it is for life.
XenotypeDef.descriptionShort: A sleepless queen momo of limitless appetite and fertility.
